cases.name: ownership_of_logical_operands

The native code took a variable operand as an alias and the receiver released it, so `let x = y or "d"` freed the string `y` still named (heap-use-after-free under ASan). cases.name: ownership_of_logical_operands_dynamic
cases.note: `a && b`, `a || b` and `x or y` evaluate to one of their operands. The native code took a variable operand as an alias and the receiver released it, so `let x = y or "d"` freed the string `y` still named (heap-use-after-free under ASan). A condition that is such an expression has to release the operand it was handed.
